name: Bullet Threading
description: Draws the outline path from the outermost ancestor down to the list item holding the caret.
author: Baram

settings.label: Thread colour
settings.description: Pick one of the theme colours, or type any CSS colour

settings.label: Branch into each item
settings.description: Off leaves only the vertical rails, with no line turning in

settings.label: Marker at the caret
settings.description: How the item you are in is picked out from the rest of the thread

settings.label: Only while editing
settings.description: Hides the thread when the editor does not have focus
